**Software Engineer II, SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEERING**

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We’re looking for a talented full stack developer as an independent contributor to join our Technology Reliability Engineering team in the role of Software Engineer II, Reliability Engineering.

This indivisual will have a strong software engineering background, a demonstrated ability to influence, partner and build cutting edge development, drive the execution, and show a passion for learning. This critically important position will have a track record of helping to deliver reliable and observable digital experiences through the application of concepts from Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, and other relevant disciplines.

**WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON**

Site Reliability Engineers are blessed to work with a variety of technologies and teams, have the opportunity to solve complex issues, and contribute to the most important areas of Kotak’s global business and products.

As a Software Engineer II, Site Reliability Engineering you will:

* Partner with domain engineers, product, and operations to identify and address risks, vulnerabilities, and limits in our system before they lead to large-scale issues
* Improve the availability, reliability, and observability of Kotak’s services and reduce the burden of human toil with development of tools, automation, or process change
* Identify, curate, and adapt key metrics for not only system health and performance, but for team success
* Create and promote a great work environment and positive team culture that optimizes team success and safety; where different backgrounds, cultures, industries and life experiences are valued
* Coach assigned SW I engineers on problem-solving, analysis and development work
* Collaborate with SRE technical leads and other Reliability leaders to identify training and up-skilling opportunities
Hands-on Technical capabilities on observability tools. Grafana, SignalFx/Splunk, NewRelic specific will be value add. The candidate shall be responsible to get the required libraries delivered through the reporting team. Strong hold on 1-2 programming languages with AWS services experience.  

**WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH**

The Sofrware Engineer II will lead a independent contributor and a team player focused on delivering reliabile and observable software used by millions of Kotak’s customers. You will be a part of the Site Reliability Engineering group which includes Observability Engineering, Chaos Engineering, Availability, Toil Reduction (Automations).

While a variety of engagement methods exist, SREs are primarily embedded with product delivery teams across Global Technology. This team member will work with those scrum teams and all the roles adjacent and therein. These product delivery teams can span all of Kotak’s most critical digital Mobile Banking Applications.

In order to deliver Site Reliability Engineering goals, you will partner and influence the entire Tech Organization

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Bachelors degree and 4+ years work experience as a software engineer of product/solutions
* Thorough understanding of how to deliver software with reliability and resilience concepts
* Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating software using modern cloud-based techniques and micro-service architecture patterns
* Ability to build strong relationships with partners/stakeholders and use influence to drive positive change
* A history of finding and reducing toil within complex systems and processes
* Experience with modern observability tooling, processes, and mindset
* A passion for learning, teaching, and mentoring
* And most importantly, a strong desire for building and motivating teams focused on continuous improvement

job.title: CTO and Co Founder with Investment (MH, IN)
job.description:
**Company Description**

FlocknGo is a community-first platform designed for organizers of paid group activities and the professionals who join them, replacing fragmented tools like messaging apps, forms, spreadsheets, and payment screenshots with a single streamlined solution.

Organizers can list their communities and events on a discovery portal that is searchable on Google and promoted through social channels, manage bookings and payments with one link, and run operations from a unified dashboard.

Participants can easily discover relevant trekking groups, workshops, business clubs, and social communities, book in one tap via familiar channels, and receive confirmations and updates directly on WhatsApp without joining new groups.

The platform emphasizes data privacy, ensuring phone numbers and personal information are never shared, and is already trusted by run clubs, farms, board game organizers, cultural clubs, and professional communities.

FlocknGo focuses on building lasting communities rather than just selling tickets, creating value for both organizers and members.

**Role Description**

As CTO and Co Founder with Investment at FlocknGo, you will lead the technical vision, architecture, and execution of our community-first platform while actively shaping product direction and long-term strategy.

In this internship hybrid role based in the Pune/Pimpri-Chinchwad Area, you will split time between on-site collaboration with the founding team and remote work, designing and implementing scalable software solutions that support organizers and members.

Day-to-day, you will oversee end-to-end software development, guide product and feature prioritization, manage technical projects and timelines, and ensure that our infrastructure and architecture can grow with the business.

You will collaborate closely with product, design, and operations to translate user feedback into robust functionality, maintain high standards of security and data privacy, and experiment with new technologies to enhance performance and user experience.

As a co-founder with an investment mindset, you will contribute to fundraising discussions, resource planning, and growth decisions, demonstrating strong ownership, resilience, and hunger to build and scale a category-defining platform.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Software Development, with experience building and maintaining web or mobile applications.
* Ability to drive Product Development, including feature scoping, prioritization, and iterative releases aligned with user needs.
* Experience in IT Strategy and technical Architecture, covering scalability, security, data privacy, and system reliability.
* Proficiency in Project Management, coordinating timelines, resources, and cross-functional collaboration in a startup environment.
* Background in modern tech stacks (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React/React Native, or similar), databases, and cloud platforms.
* Comfort working in a hybrid setup in the Pune/Pimpri-Chinchwad Area, with the ability to collaborate in person and work independently from home.
* This role is ideal for a tech wizard or a recently exited startup veteran who is hungry to build and scale another venture from the ground up.

**The Blueprint:**

* Stack: Python/Django, Flutter, React.js, hosted on AWS.
* Team: Managing 5 developers.
* Location: Remote (Pune preferred for occasional in-person collaboration).
* Commitment: Full-time preferred, but open to part-time for the right architect.
* Upside: Competitive terms with significant equity participation.
* If you are a builder who wants technical autonomy and serious skin in the game, let’s talk.
* Compensation is more of equity, so anyone looking for a regular job, please skip. This role is for entrepreneurs at heart looking for the next big challenge and opportunity.

**Job Description**

Position Title: **Technical Lead - Enterprise Product Engineering**
  
Position Type: Full Time, Permanent
  
Department: Research and Development
  
Location: Hyderabad
  
Reports to: R&D Manager, India Development Centre.

*This is a full-time, office-based position. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.*

**Company Overview:**

Cglia is a software development company dedicated to building secure, highly available, cloud-based enterprise products that help accelerate research in drug discovery, medical devices, and treatments - ultimately improving global health and well-being.
  
  
At Cglia, we are passionate about creating innovative, intuitive software that exceeds customer expectations. We foster a culture of continuous learning, engineering excellence, and accountability where professionals grow into accomplished product builders.

As a Technical Lead - Enterprise Product Engineering, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for the design, development, enhancement, and modernization of Cglia's enterprise software products. You will lead engineers through architecture and design decisions, implementation, testing, and release to ensure high-quality delivery, while remaining close enough to the technology to solve complex problems and raise engineering standards. You will also play an active role in hiring, mentoring, performance feedback, and team development while working closely with the R&D Manager.
  
You should bring strong full-stack technical depth, enterprise product development experience, sound judgment, and the ability to lead both technology and people without losing hands-on connection to the work.

  
  

*Experienced professionals who are ready to take on a senior technical leadership role are encouraged to apply. If you enjoy solving complex problems, guiding teams, and building high-quality enterprise products - we want to hear from you.*

* Own technical design and delivery of new features, product enhancements, and modernization initiatives across existing product lines.
* Guide the complete SSDLC, including solution design, estimation, implementation, testing, release readiness, and production support.

* Collaborate closely with the R&D Manager on planning, priorities, resource needs, delivery commitments, and people decisions.
* Take ownership of additional technical leadership responsibilities as required by the role or organization.
  

  

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6+ years of hands-on experience developing enterprise or cloud-based software products.
* Minimum 2 years in a technical leadership role with responsibility for mentoring developers and leading delivery.
* Strong expertise in Java, Spring/Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, REST APIs, and related enterprise Java technologies.
* Strong experience with frontend technologies such as Angular or React, along with JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Proficiency with SQL and relational databases such as MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software architecture, security, scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Experience with automated testing, code quality practices, CI/CD, source control, and modern DevOps practices.

* Exposure to cloud platforms and application modernization approaches is preferred.
  

  

**Leadership & Communication:**

* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing technical teams.
* Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to work across technical and business teams.
* Ability to make sound technical decisions, challenge the status quo, and balance modernization with product delivery needs.
* Highly organized, accountable, collaborative, and results-driven.
  

  

*We are looking for experienced Technical Leads who are passionate about building secure, scalable enterprise products, developing strong engineering teams, and owning what they deliver.*

job.title: ADAS Architect - Simulation, Data & Verification Platform @ L&T Technology Services Ltd. (KA, IN)
job.description:
LNT/AA-D-VP/1873371

* DEIC-L&T Precision Engineering & Systems IC
* Bengaluru

**Skills**
----------

#### **Knowledge & Posting Location**

Simulation and modeling Matlab simulink model development HIL sil mil and hil testing

#### **Minimum Qualification**

Bachelor of Technology (BTech) & Master of Technology (MTech)

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

ADAS Architect - Simulation, Data & Verification Platform

**About the team**
==================

You will join a focused team of domain experts building a greenfield, in-house L2+ ADAS software stack for Indian road conditions, covering four-wheelers and two-wheelers. The team designs and owns the complete architecture, algorithms, and tooling, from first principles through to deployment on automotive-grade ECUs. Engineers here shape foundational technical decisions, work directly with experts across perception, fusion, driving functions, motion control, and simulation, and see their work carried from concept to vehicle.

**Role purpose**
================

The Simulation, Data & Verification Platform Architect defines and builds the engineering platform on which every ADAS algorithm in the organization is developed, verified, and released. This is not the integration or configuration of an existing framework: the role creates, from the ground up, a proprietary simulation engine and developer application, the automated verification and reporting system that runs on it, and the data platform that feeds both, from recorded vehicle data through labelling to cloud-scale execution.

The platform is the primary evidence base for every function, before and after vehicles are available. Its correctness, determinism, and traceability directly determine the credibility of every result the organization reports. The role calls for a senior architect with deep software engineering skill, strong automotive domain understanding, and a record of building platforms that entire engineering teams depend on.

**Key responsibilities**
========================

**Simulation engine and developer application**

* Architect and build a proprietary simulation engine that executes any algorithm component delivered as a host-agnostic C-API library, discovering the component's ports and configuration at run time rather than through hand-written integration.
* Define the execution model: closed-loop simulation, deterministic resimulation against recorded data, and pure replay as distinct, well-defined modes; multi-rate scheduling; and multi-component pipelines in which any stage can run live, stubbed, or injected from a recording.
* Design and build the interactive developer application: timeline and transport control, 2D/3D scene view, signal plots, port and message inspection, layer-based visualization contributed by each component as plug-ins, and side-by-side comparison of runs.
* Guarantee traceability: every value displayed or reported is traceable to the recording, message, build, and configuration that produced it, and the headless command-line interface produces answers identical to the GUI.
* Establish determinism as a measured property: bit-exact resimulation within and across processes, and tracked, explained differences across builds and machines.
* Provide process isolation, timeouts, and crash capture so that a failing component never takes down a run or a campaign.
* Integrate external simulators and scenario tools (e.g., CarMaker, CARLA, esmini) through codecs and adapters, without coupling any algorithm component to a specific tool.

**Automated verification and reporting framework**

* Design and build, from zero, the automated test framework that runs scenario campaigns on the simulation engine: scenario definitions with machine-checkable acceptance criteria, parameter sweeps, and NCAP-based and India-specific scenario libraries.
* Build automated reporting for every campaign: per-scenario verdicts with evidence, function KPIs, coverage against requirements, trend and regression tracking, and drill-down from any failed case to the exact moment in the recording.
* Implement regression gates in CI that block a change when a KPI, scenario outcome, or determinism check regresses.
* Link verification results to requirements so that traceability and coverage reports are generated automatically, never maintained by hand.

**Data platform: recordings, storage, labelling, and cloud execution**

* Define the recording data model and formats (e.g., MCAP, MDF4, rosbag), including embedded schemas and provenance (vehicle, sensor set, software build, configuration, and scenario identity).
* Architect storage and data management for large volumes of vehicle recordings: ingestion from test vehicles, indexing, metadata and search, retention, dataset versioning, and access control.
* Establish labelling and annotation pipelines for ground truth: tool selection or development, auto-labelling, quality control, annotation specifications, and management of external annotation vendors.
* Build scenario extraction and mining from recorded data, turning field drives into reusable, parameterized test scenarios.
* Architect cloud and cluster execution of resimulation and scenario campaigns at scale (thousands of runs), including job orchestration, containerization, cost control, and reproducibility of every run.

**Technical leadership**

* Own the technical roadmap of the platform and make build-versus-buy decisions with clear justification.
* Set engineering standards for the platform: code quality, testing, documentation, and backward compatibility of interfaces.
* Work with algorithm, perception, test, and integration teams as internal customers, and with the ECU-in-the-Loop Test & Release Architect so that SIL, HIL, and vehicle results share one reporting system.
* Mentor engineers and, as the platform grows, build and lead the team around it.

**Required qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's or Master's degree (PhD a plus) in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related discipline.
* 7-15 years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years architecting simulation, SIL/HIL, data, or verification platforms for ADAS, autonomous driving, or robotics.
* Demonstrated design and delivery, from scratch, of a simulation or resimulation platform adopted as the primary development and regression tool of an engineering organization.
* Expert-level C++ (C++17) and Python: C ABIs, dynamic library loading, plug-in architectures, cross-language bindings, and performance-critical, multi-threaded code on Windows and Linux.
* Experience building desktop engineering applications with rich visualization (e.g., Qt, Dear ImGui, OpenGL/Vulkan, or equivalent).
* Deep knowledge of recorded-data formats and large-scale handling of automotive sensor data (camera, radar, lidar, vehicle bus).
* Hands-on experience with ground-truth labelling and annotation workflows for ADAS data, including quality metrics.
* Proven experience with cloud or cluster execution (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, containerized batch workloads) for simulation or data processing at scale.
* Strong knowledge of build, packaging, and CI (CMake, Conan or equivalent, and modern CI systems).
* Experience with schema-driven interfaces (e.g., Protocol Buffers) and long-term interface versioning.
* Working knowledge of ADAS function behaviour, NCAP test protocols, and scenario-based testing (ASAM OpenSCENARIO / OpenDRIVE).

**Preferred qualifications**
============================

* Experience building a scenario-mining or data-driven test-generation pipeline from fleet or test-vehicle data.
* Experience with auto-labelling using offline perception models.
* Experience with verification in regulated contexts (ISO 26262, ISO 21448 SOTIF, ASPICE) and with tool qualification.
* Contributions to open-source simulation, robotics, or data tooling.
* Experience leading or growing a platform team.
* Advanced use of AI-assisted software development tools to accelerate platform development.

**Key competencies**
====================

* Ability to explain complex trade-offs clearly to engineers and leadership to drive technical decisions.
* Architectural judgement: designs that stay simple as components, functions, and data volumes grow by orders of magnitude.
* Uncompromising rigor in determinism, traceability, and reproducibility: a result that cannot be traced is not accepted as a result.
* A product mindset toward internal tools: engineers adopt the platform because it is the fastest way to work, not because it is mandated.
* Ownership from first design to organization-wide daily use, without reliance on handoffs.
* Ability to build new systems where architecture and processes are still being defined, and to make them the reference for the organization.
* Clear technical communication with engineers, architects, and management.

**L&T Company Overview / About Us:**
====================================

L&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer–focussed approach and the constant quest for top-class quality have enabled L&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades.

Given L&T’s capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well-established capabilities in L&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics & Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design & Manufacturing (ESDM). The focus products under Automotive Electronics are ADAS, Electrification & Connectivity related products.
